name: LangChain
def: is an open-source framework for developing applications powered by large language models (LLMs), simplifying their integration with external data and computation.

name: LlamaIndex
def: is an open-source data orchestration framework for building large language model (LLM) applications.

name: AutoGen
def: is an open-source framework for building AI agents that can converse and collaborate to solve tasks.

name: RAG
def: is an AI framework that enhances large language models by retrieving relevant information from external knowledge bases to ground generated responses.

name: CoT
def: is a prompt engineering technique that guides Large Language Models (LLMs) to break down complex problems into intermediate, logical steps.

name: RLHF
def: is a machine learning technique that uses human feedback to optimize AI models, particularly Large Language Models, to align with human preferences and values.

name: ReAct
def: is a framework enabling LLMs to interleave reasoning steps with external actions for dynamic problem-solving.

name: LangGraph
def: is an open-source AI agent framework built on LangChain for orchestrating complex, stateful generative AI workflows using a graph-based architecture.

name: Hugging Face
def: is an open-source platform and community providing tools, models, and datasets for building, training, and deploying GenAI and LLMs.

name: GPT API
def: is a programmatic interface providing access to OpenAI's Generative Pre-trained Transformer models for integration into various applications.

name: Claude API
def: is a RESTful API providing programmatic access to Anthropic's Claude AI models for advanced GenAI applications.

name: AWS Bedrock
def: is a fully managed service providing access to foundation models for building and scaling generative AI applications.

name: Gemma
def: is a family of lightweight, state-of-the-art open models developed by Google DeepMind, based on Gemini technology.

name: Gemini
def: is Google's family of multimodal large language models (LLMs) designed to understand and operate across various data types.

name: Multi-agent orchestration
def: is the process of coordinating multiple AI agents to work together in a structured, goal-oriented way.

name: Chroma
def: is an open-source, AI-native vector database designed for efficiently storing and querying embeddings and metadata.

name: FAISS
def: is an open-source library by Meta AI for efficient similarity search and clustering of dense vectors.

name: Semantic chunking
def: is a sophisticated strategy that divides text into meaningful, semantically coherent segments based on content and context, rather than arbitrary size limits.

name: Vectorization
def: is the process of converting diverse data into numerical representations (vectors) for AI systems to understand and process efficiently.

name: Performance tuning
def: is the process of optimizing agentic AI systems to enhance their efficiency, reliability, and cost-effectiveness across complex, autonomous tasks.

name: Evaluation metrics
def: is a set of measurements used to assess the performance, reliability, and safety of autonomous AI agents across complex, multi-step tasks.

name: Agent observability
def: is the ability to see, understand, and explain what AI agents are doing across systems with enough detail to debug, enforce guardrails, and prove compliance.

name: Tracing
def: is a critical observability technique for agentic AI, capturing the complete execution path of agent workflows.

name: Python
def: is a versatile, high-level programming language widely adopted in Data Science and Machine Learning for its simplicity and extensive libraries.

name: SQL
def: is a standard language for managing and querying data in relational databases, essential for data storage, retrieval, and manipulation.

name: Pandas
def: is an open-source Python library providing high-performance, easy-to-use data structures and analysis tools for manipulating and analyzing structured data.

name: Scikit-learn
def: is an open-source Python machine learning library providing simple and efficient tools for predictive data analysis.

name: TensorFlow
def: is an open-source machine learning platform developed by Google for building and deploying ML models.

name: PyTorch
def: is an open-source deep learning framework that provides flexible tensor computation with strong GPU acceleration.

name: JAX/Tunix
def: is a JAX-native library designed to streamline the post-training of Large Language Models (LLMs).

name: SpaCy
def: is a free, open-source library for advanced Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Python, designed for production use.

name: NLTK
def: is a leading open-source Python library for working with human language data, providing tools for various NLP tasks.

name: Statistics
def: is the science of collecting, analyzing, interpreting, and presenting data to extract meaningful insights and make informed decisions.

name: Regression
def: is a supervised machine learning technique used to model and predict a continuous target variable based on one or more input features.

name: Model tuning
def: is the process of optimizing a machine learning model's hyperparameters to achieve the best possible performance on unseen data.

name: EDA
def: is the initial process of investigating datasets to summarize their main characteristics, often using statistical graphics and data visualization methods.

name: Data storytelling
def: is the practice of combining data, visualizations, and narrative to communicate data-driven insights in a clear and impactful way.

name: Power BI
def: is Microsoft's business analytics platform that helps turn data into actionable insights through interactive visualizations.

name: Tableau
def: is a powerful visual analytics platform that helps people and organizations see, understand, and act on data by transforming raw data into interactive visualizations and dashboards.

name: Clinical text mining
def: is extracting structured information from unstructured clinical narratives using natural language processing and machine learning.

name: Sentiment analysis
def: is the process of computationally determining the emotional tone (positive, negative, or neutral) expressed in text data.

name: AWS Lambda
def: is a serverless, event-driven compute service that runs code in response to events and automatically manages the underlying compute resources.

name: API Gateway
def: is a server that acts as a single entry point for clients to access backend services, managing API requests and enforcing policies.

name: DynamoDB
def: is a fully managed, serverless NoSQL database service from AWS that supports key-value and document data models.

name: GCP
def: is a suite of cloud computing services providing scalable, secure infrastructure for building, deploying, and managing applications.

name: FastAPI
def: is a modern, high-performance Python web framework for building APIs, leveraging standard Python type hints for data validation and automatic documentation.

name: Firebase
def: is a Google-backed Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS) platform providing a comprehensive suite of cloud services for building and scaling web and mobile applications.

name: Git
def: is a distributed version control system used to track changes in source code and data, enabling collaborative development and infrastructure management.

name: CI/CD
def: is an automated workflow that builds, tests, and deploys software and infrastructure changes reliably and frequently.

name: VS Code
def: is a lightweight, open-source code editor widely used for infrastructure management and development across various platforms.
